footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Driven Brands: includes a $12.8M income tax benefit, $8.1M from discontinued operations; after $9.1M attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 27, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 6.3% to $1.9B in 2025 (ended Dec 27, 2025). Operating income rose 15.7% to $231M, a 12.4% margin.
Net income was $131M, or $0.85 per share, after a $292M loss a year earlier. Operating cash flow was $331M and free cash flow $108M, versus −$44.7M.
watch: Net income includes a $12.8M tax benefit.
sources: Driven Brands Holdings Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
